evidence: In situ spectroscopic ellipsometry monitored the Si 3N4 film growth versus substrate temperature and reactant exposure time. Rutherford back scattering measurements revealed an Si/N ratio of 1:1.35 as expected for stoichiometric Si 3N4 deposition. The surface topography of the Si 3N4 films measured with atomic force microscopy (AFM ) was nearly identical to the initial Si(100) substrate indicating extremely smooth and conformal Si3N4 deposition. Transmission FTIR spectroscopy was utilized to measure both surface chlorine (SiCl*) and amino (SiNH 2*) species during the SiCl 4 and NH3 half-reactions.
